input.description: A volunteer provides dated screenshots showing a coordinator repeatedly sending insulting and degrading messages after the volunteer asked for the messages to stop.
A player reports recurring unwanted comments from another adult member during practice, but does not provide the wording, dates, witnesses, or whether the conduct continued after an objection.
A committee member reports repeated threatening voice messages stating that the member would be punished for raising concerns, with copies of three messages attached to the synthetic report.
A participant reports repeated mocking comments connected to the participant's accent. It is unclear whether access to activities was also restricted, and no witness accounts were supplied.
A staff member says a supervisor made one unwanted humiliating remark in a private meeting, but the exact statement, context, date, and any subsequent behavior are missing.
